subject: Re: Kickoff: romanized language ID for ingestion routing
body: Decision from Thursday's review: we integrate LID v1 into the ingestion router for the 12 languages where we have both Aksharantar lexicons and Dakshina supervision, and we hold the remaining languages behind a quality gate rather than shipping the ~6-point-worse tier. Milan's router spike showed the swap is low-risk (shadow mode first, two-week bake). Timeline: shadow deployment by May 29, decision review June 4, full cutover before the window closes June 8 — comfortably ahead of the Corpus v2 freeze on July 10. The B-A macro-F1 gains (+3.4) go in the OKR readout. Carmen, please finalize the eval dashboard so the shadow-mode diff is readable by non-team folks. Nice work all — this one's been unusually smooth. Dmitri
